ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous low-intensity region occupies the medial-left portion of the visible fluke. The central and distal regions consist of a high-intensity background punctuated by approximately 15 discrete low-intensity focal spots (mottling) and a concentrated dark region at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The visible continuous trailing edge exhibits irregular serrations consisting of approximately 15 low-amplitude peaks and valleys (ranging from 2-8 pixels in depth) isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible right lobe boundary follows a mathematical convex curve tapering from the medial spray occlusion to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters including dark spots in the central-upper region and light-colored circular marks near the distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of at least three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) crossing the high-intensity central surface, including one prominent diagonal mark in the upper-mid quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct hook-shaped low-intensity pigmentation mark located in the upper-central ventral region; the distal tip exhibits irregular, high-relief texture suggesting physical trauma or unique calcification.
